eclipse.shadowsovereign.title: Eclipse Reborn
eclipse.shadowsovereign.hud_help: Drag a panel. Select it to change its visibility.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.old_content_desc: Every earlier system remains available below.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.radar_descriptio: 48-block ally range. Enemy marks require sight within 24 blocks. Tap an ally to select it.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.search: Search names, mods or guide topics…
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mastery_help: One rank per 50 kills after 225. Each rank trims the role trigger cooldown by 0.5s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.backup_help: Choose a reserve below. Outside missions, it deploys 8s after this companion falls.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.energy_help: Regenerate 4 energy per second, starting 3s after your last cast. Death and login never refill it.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.unavailable: Unavailable: check ownership, range, unlocks, resources and cooldowns.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.party_hint: Mission party: %s selected — tap to choose
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mission_help: Choose 1–4 allies. An empty selection uses eligible allies. Start near your Warfront Beacon.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.reactor_help: Use G at a vent with a nearby ally. Open vents reduce pressure but release enemies. Stay between 20 and 80.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.investigation_he: Use G near each clue. Compare the evidence and accuse one of three suspects.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.clue.1: The witness confirms suspect %s used a different path.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.clue.2: The final signature matches suspect %s. Compare all three clues.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.victory: Victory recorded! Your reward was granted exactly once.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.failed: Mission ended: %s. Your army and gear remain safe.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.board_help: Select your unit, move to a free square, then attack. Medics may heal an ally instead. Pass ends the turn.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.camp_description: Craft stations with vanilla materials. Use them within 8 blocks. Banks and stock belong to you.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.foreign_station: This station belongs to another player.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.recipe.0: 1 glass bottle + 2 amethyst + 1 redstone. Restores 40 energy; 60s cooldown.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.recipe.1: 1 glass bottle + 1 amethyst + 1 iron. Shields the selected nearby ally for 3 HP, 10s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.recipe.2: 1 stick + 1 amethyst + 1 glowstone. Marks up to 8 enemies near the aimed point for 8s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.report_help: Finish an encounter to see real companion damage, kills, healing and Soul Arts.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.role_desc.guardi: After damage: +0.2 knockback resistance for 6s; 12s trigger cooldown.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.role_desc.strike: Third melee hit in a 5s window adds 2 base magic damage; 12s trigger cooldown.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.role_desc.assass: An opening hit after 3s without damage weakens its target for 4s; 12s trigger cooldown.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.role_desc.medic: A confirmed kill heals a nearby injured ally for 2 HP; 12s trigger cooldown.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.deep: Feeding grants +1 bond; the 150 cap remains.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.clea: Soul Arts cooldown is 10% shorter. Switching never resets it.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.quic: Follow catch-up threshold is 4 blocks shorter.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.rall: A finished plan heals 1 HP, at most once per 30s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.ligh: A new rune costs 7 amethyst instead of 8. Copper cost is unchanged.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.talent_desc.cons: A companion kill restores 1 energy, at most once per 2s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.power_desc.dash: Move up to 6 blocks across safe ground. Stops at obstacles.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.power_desc.well: Pull up to six visible enemies toward your aimed point for 4s.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.power_desc.lance: Pierce up to three visible enemies for 6 magic damage. Range 24 blocks.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.power_desc.parry: A 0.6s frontal window blocks up to 8 damage and reflects up to 4 at a nearby attacker.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.power_desc.storm: Six pulses across 3s, 2 damage each, up to six enemies within four blocks.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.eclips: Five rooms and four choices of temporary cards. Full victory grants five seals.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.reacto: Manage three vents and keep pressure in the safe zone for 120 seconds.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.invest: Read three clues, identify the culprit, then face its sentinels.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.board: A turn-based 8×8 battle. Your real companions cannot be hurt. Cosmetic wins only.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.crysta: Break three shield crystals and overcome two guarded phase transitions.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.chrono: A boss strikes your previous positions after warnings. Keep moving.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.card_desc.night_: A 3-HP shield at each room start. Pause cannot refill it.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.card_desc.clear_: Soul Arts cooldown is 20% shorter this run.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.station_desc.qua: Refill or deposit real backpacks. Chest + crafting table + 2 copper + amethyst.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.station_desc.alc: Craft real consumables. Brewing stand + 2 amethyst + glass bottle.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.station_desc.mer: Three saved offers. Lectern + 4 gold nuggets + amethyst.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.station_desc.gal: Use to display your selected companion. 3 smooth stone + glass pane + amethyst.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.station_desc.way: Four gates in this dimension. Channel 5s, cost 50 energy, cooldown 120s. 8 obsidian + Echo Compass.

eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.1.desc: A new H dashboard links every new and retained system.

eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.2.desc: Move, scale and hide panels; save your layout locally.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.3.name: Tactical Radar
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.3.desc: Track allies and visible enemies without loading terrain.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.4.name: Multi-selection
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.4.desc: Select up to 24 owned companions for group orders.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.5.name: Battle Debriefs
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.5.desc: Inspect real per-companion combat results across 20 encounters.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.6.name: Interactive Guide
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.6.desc: Search all thirty systems and follow the next suggested step.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.7.name: Combat Roles
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.7.desc: Equip Guardian, Striker, Assassin or Medic near your workshop.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.8.name: Talent Web
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.8.desc: Spend three points unlocked at levels 3, 6 and 10 on nine utility talents.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.9.name: Veteran Mastery
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.9.desc: Every fifty kills beyond 225 adds a rank, up to five.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.10.name: Gear Blueprints
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.10.desc: Save three equipment sets. Applying uses real items and preserves their NBT.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.11.name: Reserve Relay
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.11.desc: Choose a backup ally that deploys after a companion falls outside missions.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.12.name: Soul Wardrobe
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.12.desc: Choose earned aura colors, summoning seals and name frames.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.13.name: Sovereign Energy
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.13.desc: A saved 100-point resource powers your personal abilities.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.14.name: Shadow Dash
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.14.desc: Dash up to six safe blocks without changing your weapon.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.15.name: Gravity Well
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.15.desc: Pull nearby eligible enemies toward a targeted point.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.16.name: Spectral Lance
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.16.desc: Aim a piercing magic line at up to three enemies.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.17.name: Royal Parry
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.17.desc: Time a frontal guard to block and reflect an incoming attack.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.18.name: Soul Storm
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.18.desc: Hold an area with six magical damage pulses.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.19.name: Eclipse Expedition
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.19.desc: Build a temporary deck while clearing five combat rooms.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.20.name: Soul Reactor
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.20.desc: Balance pressure against enemy releases at three vents.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.21.name: Echo Investigation
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.21.desc: Collect readable clues and identify the culprit before the fight.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.22.name: Eclipse Board
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.22.desc: Play a saved turn-based strategy game using companion-inspired pieces.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.23.name: Glassheart Sentinel
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.23.desc: Challenge a shield-crystal boss with protected phase transitions.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.24.name: Chronophage
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.24.desc: Outmaneuver a boss that attacks your previous positions.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.25.name: Soul Vault
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.25.desc: Store 27 slots of real items in your owner-bound camp bank.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.26.name: Quartermaster
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.26.desc: Distribute food and arrows or deposit selected backpacks into the vault.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.27.name: Soul Laboratory
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.27.desc: Craft Focus Draughts, Ward Phials and Scouting Flares.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.28.name: Echo Merchant
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.28.desc: Trade earned seals through offers that refresh after combat victories.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.29.name: Trophy Gallery
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.29.desc: Place a non-ticking miniature of your selected companion in the world.
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.30.name: Waygate Network
eclipse.shadowsovereign.feature.30.desc: Connect four personal gates in the same dimension with safe channeled travel.
royal.shadowsovereign.title: The Shadow Monarch's Codex
royal.shadowsovereign.home_help: Choose a company, or turn a new page.
royal.shadowsovereign.old_citadel_help: Roles, talents, powers, camp and every retained Eclipse feature.
royal.shadowsovereign.team_help: %s selected. Tap a member to add or remove them. Tap the title to name your company.
royal.shadowsovereign.name: Name: %s
royal.shadowsovereign.import_help: Choose a tactical squad, then select up to 24 members below. Its original settings stay saved.
royal.shadowsovereign.desk_needed: Craft a Sovereign Desk and place it nearby to purchase upgrades.
royal.shadowsovereign.purchase_help: Uses the real materials in your main inventory. Energy and cooldowns stay as they are.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.extract: Each level gives a one-percent chance: 1% at level 1, up to 10% at level 10. Every attempt is independent.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.dash: Each upgrade adds a quarter block of safe ground travel. Maximum: 8.25 blocks.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.well: Each upgrade adds 0.2 blocks to the pull radius, up to 6.8. Target cap stays six.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.lance: Each upgrade adds 0.5 base magic damage. Maximum: 10.5.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.parry: Each upgrade blocks 0.5 more damage, up to 12.5. Timing and reflection are unchanged.
royal.shadowsovereign.skill_desc.storm: Each upgrade adds 0.1 damage per pulse. Maximum: 2.9.
royal.shadowsovereign.beacon_required: Start near your bound Warfront Beacon.
royal.shadowsovereign.sanctuary_required: Open the retained journal for its unlocks and Sanctuary requirements.
royal.shadowsovereign.comparison_help: Compare native item attributes and enchantments before equipping. Special mod abilities may behave differently; test them in the training court.
royal.shadowsovereign.real_test: Try it in the training court
royal.shadowsovereign.supply_help: Targets count all suitable food together and all arrows together. Supplies come from your real vault near the Quartermaster.
royal.shadowsovereign.bags_help: Four companions per page, five real storage slots each. Put down the carried stack before turning a page.
royal.shadowsovereign.rally_help: Place a Field Standard while this company is selected. Gather within 64 blocks using normal paths.
royal.shadowsovereign.wishlist_help: Pin up to five hunting wishes
royal.shadowsovereign.bestiary_help: Recorded attempts begin with this update. Wishes mark visible nearby creatures, without revealing hidden terrain.
royal.shadowsovereign.memories_help: The last twenty souls that answered your call.
royal.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.training: A sixty-second court for you and up to four allies. No kills, loot or combat rewards. Damage cannot finish your party.
royal.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.skill_co: Dash through the gate, strike three seals with Lance, then Parry an arrow. Requires two Eclipse wins, Survival and unlocked Parry. Challenging lasts 90 seconds.
royal.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.seal_puz: Turn every seal dark. A tap changes its stone and the four neighboring stones. No army or combat currency is needed.
royal.shadowsovereign.mode_desc.mimic: An illusionist copies your last power after a two-second warning. Three Eclipse wins and one to four allies required.
royal.shadowsovereign.course_step.0: Aim your Dash through the violet gate.
royal.shadowsovereign.course_step.1: Use Spectral Lance on the three glowing targets.
royal.shadowsovereign.course_step.2: Face the archer and time your Royal Parry.
royal.shadowsovereign.copy_warning: He is copying %s. Move or prepare!
royal.shadowsovereign.mimic_help: Watch the announced copy; ordinary weapons still work.
royal.shadowsovereign.risk_help: Choose one before starting an Eclipse Expedition. Victory grants two extra seals, once.
royal.shadowsovereign.risk.2: Crowded halls · two extra enemies per room
royal.shadowsovereign.puzzle_help: A tap flips the selected seal and its adjacent neighbors. Darken all sixteen seals.
royal.shadowsovereign.training_help: Begin a training session from Trials of the Monarch near your Beacon.
royal.shadowsovereign.finish_activity: Finish or pause your current activity first.
royal.shadowsovereign.supply_empty: No supplies moved. Check your vault, backpack room and Quartermaster.
royal.shadowsovereign.foreign_station: This station belongs to another monarch.
royal.shadowsovereign.unavailable: That action is not ready here. Check its requirements.
royal.shadowsovereign.course_requirement: Unlock Parry with two Eclipse wins and enter in Survival.
royal.shadowsovereign.activity_won: A new page for your story. Result saved.
royal.shadowsovereign.invalid_activity: This interrupted activity was safely closed.
royal.shadowsovereign.defeat: The trial ended. Your companions keep their souls.
royal.shadowsovereign.time_expired: Time has run out. Try another route.
royal.shadowsovereign.rescued: The charm pulled %s back from the brink.
royal.shadowsovereign.special_tooltip: Special effects remain in the item's own tooltip.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.1: Craft a Sovereign Desk and upgrade six personal skills through ten saved levels.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.2: An illustrated, touch-friendly home for your army, with matching retained menus.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.3: Browse every activity with its illustration, requirements and direct entry.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.4: Search actions in either language and pin eight favorites.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.5: Inspect actual equipment, candidate attributes, durability and native tooltips before moving an item.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.6: Choose total food and arrow targets for each company; only real vault items move.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.7: Four real companion backpacks on each native inventory page.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.8: Clear feedback explains missing materials, unavailable members and supply limits.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.9: Recorded attempts, successes and five visible-target wishes extend your Bestiary.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.10: Measure accepted damage for sixty seconds without kill, loot or reward farming.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.11: Six optional expedition rules offer two extra seals on a committed victory.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.12: A saved three-stage Dash, Lance and Parry course with relaxed and timed records.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.13: A Lance hit opens three seconds for an ally melee hit: +10% damage, capped at four, every twelve seconds.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.14: One backpack charm prevents a fatal hit outside activities, restores 25% health and saves a five-minute cooldown.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.15: Bind a visible gathering point to each company and move by normal paths.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.16: Keep the last twenty successful awakenings, their day, region, tier and trait.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.17: Solve a persistent, solvable sixteen-stone toggle puzzle for a cosmetic crest.
royal.shadowsovereign.feature_desc.18: Face an illusionist who echoes your last power after a clear warning; ordinary weapons still work.
royal.shadowsovereign.notice_open: Tap to open the next step.
royal.shadowsovereign.ascension_unlock: Requires %s completed adventures, a nearby Sanctuary and an active companion. Details on the activity page.
royal.shadowsovereign.soul_faded: The soul slipped away. Another hunt awaits.
royal.shadowsovereign.old_activity: An adventure is already in progress. Open the atlas to return to it.
vigil.shadowsovereign.title: The Living Vigil
vigil.shadowsovereign.welcome: They remember you. They stand with you.
vigil.shadowsovereign.ready: Your army is watching over you.
vigil.shadowsovereign.crown_help: An enemy hit leaving you below three hearts calls your active army and available reserves, within the army limit. Speed II helps them gather. They hold a moving 5×5 perimeter and do not chase outside it until your health is full. Terrain and native body sizes determine safe positions.
vigil.shadowsovereign.crown_start: Close ranks! %s companions are forming your last circle.
vigil.shadowsovereign.crown_end: You are safe again. Your companions resume their previous orders.
vigil.shadowsovereign.crown_locked: We stay with you until you are fully healed.
vigil.shadowsovereign.horn_help: Blow the crafted horn to gather your available traveling companions. Fixed sentries keep their posts. Five-second cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.bandage_help: Hold use for 1.6 seconds. One real bandage heals four HP; twenty-second cooldown. It never replaces the need to survive incoming damage.
vigil.shadowsovereign.feast_help: A real crafted meal restores food and heals up to eight nearby injured allies by four HP. Use after ten seconds without an enemy hit. Thirty-second cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.grave_help: Every companion receives five successful free returns after death. Thereafter it waits safely here. Pay manually at your owned Cemetery: one diamond per fifty maximum HP, rounded up. Thirty-second return time still applies. Failed summons never spend diamonds.
vigil.shadowsovereign.grave_needed: Place your own Soul Cemetery within eight blocks.
vigil.shadowsovereign.return_stats: Free returns left: %s · Deaths: %s · Paid return: %s diamonds
vigil.shadowsovereign.cemetery_wait: %s is resting in your Cemetery. A return costs %s diamonds; choose it at your Cemetery.
vigil.shadowsovereign.offering_help: Your optional offering purse holds actual deposited diamonds. It is used only when you press Return at an owned Cemetery. Nothing is charged automatically.
vigil.shadowsovereign.not_yours: This station belongs to another monarch.
vigil.shadowsovereign.unavailable: Not ready here. Check the companion, distance, supplies or cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.post_help: Select a loaded companion and mark its current position. Native persistence keeps the named entity through distance and chunk saves. No terrain is kept loaded for it. Follow, Stay or manual Recall ends or suspends the post.
vigil.shadowsovereign.alarm: %s: Trouble at my post — %s is approaching!
vigil.shadowsovereign.compass_help: Use a crafted Soul Compass to cycle your known sentries. It points to the saved post without loading distant terrain.
vigil.shadowsovereign.watch_help: Your five saved companies rotate through their bound standards. Overlapping members stay. Requires nearby loaded standards and a free activity slot; logout pauses the schedule.
vigil.shadowsovereign.cache_help: Look at your owned Supply Cache within six blocks, then bind it. Bind a different destination within sixty-four blocks of the source.
vigil.shadowsovereign.courier_help: The selected companion walks between your two real caches, carrying items in its five backpack slots. Full or unloaded caches pause transfers. Items are never copied.
vigil.shadowsovereign.tow_help: The partner approaches, carries the selected companion, and brings it to your starting position. Requires unmounted companions, a free activity slot and no Last Circle. Thirty-second cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.tow_done: Your companion reached the safe point.
vigil.shadowsovereign.lens_help: Use the crafted Echo Lens while aiming at a visible creature within twelve blocks. Read native health, attack attributes, armor and recruitment eligibility.
vigil.shadowsovereign.recruitable: This creature can leave an ordinary soul.
vigil.shadowsovereign.link_help: Two owned companions within eight blocks can share fifteen percent of a hit, capped at four HP, once per second. Damage is really paid by the partner, not erased.
vigil.shadowsovereign.bash_help: Aim at an enemy close to the selected ally. A real melee hit pushes and slows it. Fifteen-second cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.volley_help: Aim at a visible enemy. Up to four compatible native ranged allies fire three attacks each. Forty-five-second cooldown.
vigil.shadowsovereign.meteor_help: Aim at loaded safe ground. The selected ally leaps and its next landing strikes up to six nearby enemies. Thirty-second cooldown. Unavailable during Last Circle.
vigil.shadowsovereign.prism_help: Equip the crafted shield in a companion's offhand. It absorbs two HP from eligible hits, consuming real shield durability.
vigil.shadowsovereign.snare_help: Use the crafted snare to place one thirty-second rune on aimed ground. Its first nearby hostile visitors are slowed for three seconds. No blocks are changed.
vigil.shadowsovereign.game_requirements: Begin near your Warfront Beacon. One shared activity at a time. The Ferryman needs three Eclipse wins and one to four active allies.
vigil.shadowsovereign.mode_help.0: Rotate nine pipe tiles. Connect the west entrance to the east exit. Generated boards have a solution; best move counts persist.
vigil.shadowsovereign.mode_help.1: Tap the glowing lane on each beat. Twelve beats, six hits to win; Challenging uses a tighter timing window.
vigil.shadowsovereign.mode_help.2: Fight an abstract six-round dice duel. Strike, Defend or reroll one die per round. Your real army's HP and kills never change.
vigil.shadowsovereign.mode_help.3: Explore a generated connected maze, find both keys and reach the star. Position, moves and keys survive saving.
vigil.shadowsovereign.mode_help.4: A native wither skeleton guards the toll. Face three protected phases and dodge its announced soul strike. Win three seals, one Eclipse victory and a real trophy; Challenging adds one seal.
vigil.shadowsovereign.won: A new victory for your company.
vigil.shadowsovereign.rhythm_help: Watch the diamond and tap its lane with the beat.
vigil.shadowsovereign.ferryman_help: Keep your allies close and watch for the soul strike.
vigil.shadowsovereign.ferryman_warning: The Ferryman marks your ground. Move before the strike!
vigil.shadowsovereign.map_help: Only your saved sentry locations appear. Gold means loaded; violet means last known. No terrain is scanned or force-loaded.
vigil.shadowsovereign.album_help: Take native screenshots locally, then view them in your album. Up to twenty photos; confirm deletion yourself. No image is uploaded.
vigil.shadowsovereign.photo_saved: A memory for your field album.
vigil.shadowsovereign.greeting.0: %s: Nice to see you again, my monarch.
vigil.shadowsovereign.greeting.1: %s: It has been a long time. I kept watch.
vigil.shadowsovereign.greeting.2: %s: You came back. I knew you would.
vigil.shadowsovereign.greeting.3: %s: Welcome home. We are still here.
vigil.shadowsovereign.battle_call.1: %s: %s, hold the line. We've got this!

vigil.shadowsovereign.feature_help.30: Explore a generated connected maze, find both keys and reach the star. Position, moves and keys survive saving.
vigil.shadowsovereign.greeting_first: %s: My watch begins. I stand with you.
vigil.shadowsovereign.battle_reply.1: %s: I have your back. Keep going!
vigil.shadowsovereign.battle_reply.2: %s: For our monarch! Hold the circle!
soullife.shadowsovereign.title: Souls With Stories
soullife.shadowsovereign.feeding_help: Hold a safe food in your main hand and stand within four blocks. One real item heals two HP and builds affection; favorite food gives more. One-minute cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.pet_help: A peaceful companion turns toward you and responds with hearts. Builds one affection; ten-second cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feed: Share the food in my hand
soullife.shadowsovereign.talk_help: Listen to a nearby calm companion. Its personality and condition shape the reply. Ten-second cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.praise_help: Praise a confirmed kill made by this soul within the last minute. Each kill can be praised once after combat has settled.
soullife.shadowsovereign.comfort: I am here. You are safe.
soullife.shadowsovereign.comfort_help: Comfort a worried or recently injured soul after combat settles. Restores calm, without replacing medical care. One-minute cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.keepsake_help: Give one actual held item. It stays with this soul through death and restart. Retrieve it into your inventory when there is room.
soullife.shadowsovereign.wish.1: Let us finish a game together.
soullife.shadowsovereign.wish.2: Let us walk one hundred blocks together.
soullife.shadowsovereign.wish.3: Sit with me at our Hearth.
soullife.shadowsovereign.wish_done: %s: You remembered. That meant a lot.
soullife.shadowsovereign.footer: Your companions keep their stories, even when you are away.
soullife.shadowsovereign.empty_help: Recruit a soul, or clear the search. Your existing army appears here automatically.
soullife.shadowsovereign.discoveries_hel: Discover the thirty new care, friendship and play features.
soullife.shadowsovereign.play_safety: Use a quiet open space. Real danger interrupts play and restores normal commands; no practice game causes damage or earns kills.
soullife.shadowsovereign.fetch_help: Hold a crafted Soul Playball and throw it. Your selected ground companion chases the real item, carries it back and returns it. Pick it up if the game stops.
soullife.shadowsovereign.hide_help: Your soul walks to a safe hiding place in loaded terrain. Give it five seconds, then find it within three blocks. Ask for a clue every ten seconds.
soullife.shadowsovereign.tag_help: Your soul chases you gently for thirty seconds. Stay close enough to keep the game going. Being caught is harmless.
soullife.shadowsovereign.dance_help: Your companion turns, looks and bounces where its native body supports it. Music and notes last eight seconds.
soullife.shadowsovereign.melody_help: Teach four notes below, then ask your soul to play them. The melody stays saved with this companion.
soullife.shadowsovereign.spar_help: Two real companions approach and perform five harmless practice exchanges. Practice health is separate; no real HP, kills, items or progression are spent.
soullife.shadowsovereign.note_help: Tap to change the note, then hear it.
soullife.shadowsovereign.partner_help: Tap to cycle through your other souls.
soullife.shadowsovereign.friend_help: Bring two calm owned souls within eight blocks. Each can have three friends. Playing together grows their shared friendship.
soullife.shadowsovereign.unfriend_help: Removes only the selected friendship on both sides.
soullife.shadowsovereign.hearth_help: Craft and place your own Soul Hearth, then use it to bind your gathering place. It gives light without fire damage. Rest and stories need your Hearth within eight blocks.
soullife.shadowsovereign.hearth_needed: Visit and use your own Hearth first.
soullife.shadowsovereign.rest_help: The selected soul walks to the Hearth and settles for ten seconds. Its usual orders resume afterward.
soullife.shadowsovereign.rest_group_help: Up to six available nearby souls gather around your Hearth. Rest begins when everyone arrives.
soullife.shadowsovereign.story_help: At your Hearth, build a three-part story with your soul. Choose what happens next; the ending and memory stay with it.
soullife.shadowsovereign.choice.0: We protect the one left behind.
soullife.shadowsovereign.story_branch.0: Nobody was left alone that night.
soullife.shadowsovereign.story_branch.1: Beyond the bend, a new horizon waited.
soullife.shadowsovereign.story_branch.2: An unexpected ally joined the journey.

soullife.shadowsovereign.lifetime_stats: Games %s · Walking %s blocks · Pats %s · Meals %s · Hearth rests %s
soullife.shadowsovereign.aid_help: At 25 affection, a nearby soul can use one real Field Bandage from its backpack when you are below half health. Heals four HP; shares the twenty-second bandage cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.rescue_help: An opted-in living soul falling below the world can spend one real stored ender pearl and recall safely. Two-minute cooldown. Existing deaths, Cemetery costs and emergency-circle orders still apply.
soullife.shadowsovereign.unavailable: We cannot do that here yet. Come close, let the battle settle, check the held item or wait for the cooldown.
soullife.shadowsovereign.not_yours: This Hearth belongs to another companion keeper.
soullife.shadowsovereign.praise_reply: %s: I knew you were watching. We did well.
soullife.shadowsovereign.comfort_reply: %s: I am all right now. Stay a little longer.
soullife.shadowsovereign.aid_reply: %s: Hold still. I have a bandage for you.
soullife.shadowsovereign.rescue_reply: %s: That pearl saved me. I am safe in reserve.
soullife.shadowsovereign.friend_reunion: %s: There you are, %s! I saved a place beside me.
soullife.shadowsovereign.clue: A soft soul-light glimmers about %s blocks away.
soullife.shadowsovereign.found: %s: You found me! Your turn to choose our next game.
soullife.shadowsovereign.tagged: %s: Got you! That was a good chase.
soullife.shadowsovereign.play_done: A good moment together. Your companions remember it.
soullife.shadowsovereign.play_stopped: Let us stop here. Your companions return to their usual orders.

soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.3: Build a separate affection score through real care and shared activities, with bounded rewards.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.4: Each soul remembers a safe favorite food from the installed item registry.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.5: Share one actual held food item; favorites earn a warmer reaction.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.6: Nearby peaceful souls turn toward you and show their affection.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.7: Initiate contextual conversations in English or Arabic.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.8: Praise only this soul's recent confirmed personal victory, once per kill.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.9: Comfort an injured or worried companion without turning reassurance into free healing.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.10: Give and retrieve one real item, preserved with the soul through death and restart.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.11: Quiet mood particles and optional translated feelings beside the existing name.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.12: Twenty recent personal memories retain actual times, places and shared events.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.13: Introduce owned souls; three reciprocal friendships each grow through shared play.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.14: Set individual follow spacing while retaining formations and emergency rules.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.15: Craft a safe light-giving gathering place owned by its player.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.16: One soul or up to six nearby friends physically gather and rest beside the Hearth.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.17: Build three-part campfire tales and keep the ending as a personal memory.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.18: Throw one real reusable Playball; your companion chases it, carries it and brings it back.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.19: Find your actual soul in a loaded safe hiding place, with bounded light clues.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.20: A harmless thirty-second chase with the real companion and no combat rewards.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.21: Nearby shared walking and biome visits build real travel memories; large jumps do not count.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.22: Companions turn and bounce with native bodies and a short musical celebration.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.23: Teach a saved four-note melody and ask your companion to perform it.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.24: Two real souls practice with virtual hearts, no real damage, kills or loot.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.25: Earn seven personal crests through actual care, friendship, games, walks, rest and aid.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.26: An affectionate opted-in companion can spend its real stored bandage to help its injured owner.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.27: Each soul has an optional daily food, play, walk or rest wish with no penalty for declining.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.28: Friends recognize each other after real separation with private warm reunion dialogue.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.29: Recall today's actual care, games, walking, victories and acts of help.
soullife.shadowsovereign.feature_help.30: Opt in to a real pearl-powered recall before a living soul falls into the void.

soullife.shadowsovereign.station_waiting: %s is placed safely. Its function unlocks with Eclipse victories, or use it in Creative. Station limits still apply.
soullife.shadowsovereign.gate_frame_need: Build a four-wide, five-high frame around this Waygate: two-wide, three-high opening. The Waygate replaces one of the two bottom middle blocks. Corners are optional. Use Soul Gate Frames, obsidian or crying obsidian.
soullife.shadowsovereign.gate_clear: Clear the six inner spaces before activating the portal.
soullife.shadowsovereign.gate_locked: Waygates need three Eclipse victories or Creative mode. You may bind four Waygates in total. Your blocks remain safely placed.
soullife.shadowsovereign.gate_ready: The Soul Gate is awake. Link a second owned Waygate, then stand still inside for five seconds to travel. Cost: fifty energy; cooldown: two minutes.
soullife.shadowsovereign.gate_channel: The gate is gathering its light. Stand still for five seconds.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.1: An illustrated guide to every core system, with saved steps, recipes, destinations and release notes.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.2: A private homestead and four expedition regions beyond your crafted journey gate.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.3: Twelve chapters connect earlier adventures, your living army and the new campaign. Complete goals in any order.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.4: Build a 4×5 frame around a Journey Keystone. Entry costs 20 energy; returning is free.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.5: An illustrated command hub with book progress, destinations, crew profiles and native recipes.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.6: Clear four physical rooms. Defeat each room's guards and reach its marked seal before continuing.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.7: Record two lever actions. In the next cycle, echoes repeat them while you complete the third.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.8: Ride a real minecart through four stations. Clear ambushes and spend two copper ingots on each repair.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.9: Rotate three prisms beside you to route a visible beam from its source to the receiver.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.10: Move two groups onto separate plates, hold both after defeating guards, then reach the exit.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.11: Bring a real pickaxe. Mine eight deposits, then reach the exit before greed exhausts stability.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.12: Follow four clues between distinctive physical landmarks. Each discovery commits the next clue.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.13: Wear a carved pumpkin, question three guests and identify the saboteur from their clues.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.14: Climb the real staircase with a companion before the rising fog overtakes you.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.15: Three saved auctions with NPC bids. Only a successful winning bid spends your seals.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.16: Reach and activate three archive seals to expose the guardian during each phase.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.17: A royal boar chef launches food projectiles and marks where his next messy attack will land.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.18: Gather real arena tokens and deposit three at the marked payment stone to break his ward.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.19: Carry a sword or axe, cut four nearby silk anchors and avoid telegraphed webs.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.20: Strike the currently marked voice. The other voices remain protected until their turn.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.21: Defeat five rulers first. Three saved masks combine their mechanics in the final encounter.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.22: Three personal stages grow from real care, a preferred adventure and a shared ending.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.23: Assign interests at your club pennant. Members develop club ranks through shared victories.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.24: Affectionate companions occasionally joke and react at camp. Toggle pranks at any time.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.25: Bring three souls to the stage, guide each role and perform the scene together.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.26: A completed personal story produces a real marked letter, once for that companion.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.27: Personal endings unlock gestures you can request from a nearby calm soul.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.28: Gather three advisors and choose one of their suggested destinations.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.29: Arrange nearby companions for a real local photograph in the existing album.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.30: Lead your actual companions through four festival landmarks together.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.31: A saved 256×256 building plot in Echo Realms. Dungeon resets never erase your camp.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.32: Put real materials in your owned store. A nearby assigned soul builds the selected blueprint.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.33: Equip a hoe and mark a 9×9 farm. Harvested crops and seeds stay real; one seed is replanted.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.34: Eight dishes consume real stored ingredients and return their containers.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.35: Craft functional benches, music stands, notice boards and lamps with actual materials.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.36: Assign quiet home routines. Manual orders, danger and emergency protection take priority.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.37: Invite a saved trader with a committed identity, three offers and a personal letter.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.38: Five ranks earned through real construction, cooking, gardening and personal stories.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.39: Kick a physical ball using your aim. Companions run, kick and defend; score two goals.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.40: Aim a real rolling ball at ten practice pins. Clear them within the allowed shots.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.41: Pull on the bell's beat. The rope position and companion formation decide the round.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.42: Walk while music plays, then claim a real seat before your companions do.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.43: Pass the physical toy between nearby participants. Be empty-handed when it bursts into confetti.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.44: Choose a tile and color. A companion must walk there to paint the actual board.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.45: Two or more souls pass the same physical parcel through four checkpoints.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.46: Move on green, freeze on red, and cross with a companion. Mistakes never deal practice damage.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.47: Bronze, silver and gold reflect completed activities and real elapsed play time.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.48: Save a mode, seed, difficulty and safe rule as an offline shareable challenge code.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.feature_help.49: Twenty-four earned displayable relics, six utility families and one active slot.

odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.guide_: Use the book you received, H → Journey, or /shadow guide. The book tracks your own world progress.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.first_: Defeat eligible mobs and use manual Arise extraction. Base extraction is 1%; ordinary attempts are not guaranteed.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.summon: Original Army → select an owned soul → Summon. Leave safe ground and enough room for its native body.
Use Follow Me in Original Army or /shadow follow. K opens Original Army.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.recall: Choose Recall for a living companion. This puts it in reserve without spending a death return.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.equipp: Open a companion inventory and put real equipment in its weapon and armor slots.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.backpa: Move at least one real stack into a companion backpack. These slots are separate from equipment.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.fed: Hold safe food and feed a nearby calm soul through Soul Forge or Souls With Stories.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.level_: One specific companion must personally defeat five enemies. Owner kills do not count.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.tactic: Use an existing Step, Taunt, Barrier or Mend skill successfully. Keep a nearby eligible companion.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.sanctu: Craft Soul Sanctuary from the Recipes page, place it and right-click it.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.trial_: At your Sanctuary, finish and claim one Trial and one Lost Soul Escort.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.expedi: Dispatch a reserve expedition and claim it when ready. Complete and claim one adventure contract.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.legacy: Win a Sanctuary Siege and Rune Vault; reach wave five of Endless Gauntlet. Infinite waves are optional.
Successfully use Shadow Exchange, Eclipse Burst and a Duo Link combo. Check their old unlock requirements.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.chroni: Defeat Gravewarden, Frost Regent and Hollow Tyrant in Boss Chronicles. Relaxed clears count.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal.rift_rally: Clear a Rift and Soul Rally
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.rift_r: Finish one Branching Rift and one Soul Rally. The companion must reach Rally checkpoints with you.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal.angling_sto: Go fishing and read a story
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.anglin: Finish Spectral Angling and read an existing Journey companion story.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.ascens: Clear Ghost Heist, Domination, Mirror, Draft and Fortune Rush once each.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.journe: Claim the six original Journey chapters. Their existing requirements and rewards remain.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.warfro: Capture all six Warfront territories and defeat the final commander.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal.art_rune: Equip a Soul Art and rune
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.art_ru: Craft and equip a rune and choose a Soul Art on an owned companion.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.battle: Save a four-step plan in Living Warfront. Use real Rally, Focus, Guard and Regroup options.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.rival_: Earn and explicitly claim one commander pact after its required victory.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.sovere: Choose a champion, finish its three stages and claim the earned crest.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.eclips: Clear Expedition, Reactor, Investigation, Board, Crystal Guardian and Chronophage.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.royal_: Complete Training, Skill Course, Seal Puzzle and the Mimic encounter.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.master: Use your owned Sovereign Desk and pay the real cost of any mastery upgrade.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.compan: Add companions to a named company and bind one company standard.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.camp_s: Bind Vault, Quartermaster, Alchemy, Merchant, Gallery and Waygate after their original unlocks.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.lesson: Place and approach your Cemetery. Read: five successful free death returns, then manual diamonds ceil(max HP ÷ 50). A real death is not required.
Own a companion and read the protection lesson. An enemy hit below three hearts calls a 5×5 guard ring until full health; do not hurt yourself for this step.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.vigil_: Win Circuit, Echo Rhythm, Astral Dice, Pocket Maze and Ferryman once each.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.care_f: Pet and feed a soul, introduce a friend and complete a three-part Hearth story.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.social: Complete any three different 1.1.4 activities: fetch, hide, tag, dance, melody, spar or rest.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.realm_: Build and activate a Journey Gateway. Have a bound Sanctuary, one soul and 20 energy.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.region: Start an activity in each of the four regions. Their atlas cards show the region artwork.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.homest: Place four camp service blocks inside your saved homestead and use them to bind their locations.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.gatewa: Use the Journey return gate or Return Home. No entry energy is charged on return.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.first_: Win an Odyssey activity and explicitly claim the result.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.explor: Clear Shifting Dungeons and Loop Observatory, then claim both results.
Finish Ghost Train and Temple of Mirrors. Bring eight copper ingots for the train.
Complete Two-Company Fortress and Mine of Greed. Bring two souls and a suitable pickaxe.
Finish Trail of Treasures and Monster Masquerade. Wear a carved pumpkin for the party.
Complete Lighthouse in the Fog and win at least one Bazaar auction before claiming the visit.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.person: Complete all three personal quest stages for one soul. The Crew page lists the requirements.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.club: Assign at least two owned souls to a club at a bound club pennant.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.camp_s: Finish one architect blueprint, one real garden harvest and one kitchen dish.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.festiv: Place a camp station and equip a companion with a weapon and armor.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.goal_help.more_g: Store an item in a companion backpack and feed a companion.

odyssey.shadowsovereign.title: The Sovereign's Journey
odyssey.shadowsovereign.journey_welcome: Your army. A world of stories.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.journey_subtitle: Choose a chapter, an adventure, or a good moment together.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.activity_hint: Open controls, check the objective, pause or claim a finished adventure.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.old_systems: All earlier adventures, companies and army systems remain available.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.return_help: Return is free. Leaving an unfinished activity grants no victory.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.track_step: Pin this step on the HUD
odyssey.shadowsovereign.lesson_requireme: Cemetery lesson requires your nearby owned Cemetery. Protection requires an owned soul.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.chapter_reward: Three seals, once per chapter. Earlier completed steps count.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.ending_help: Complete every other core step first, then lead and claim the coronation parade.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.atlas_help: Start from your homestead. A physical scene will be prepared in your private region.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.difficulty_help: 0 relaxed · 1 standard · 2 challenging. All count toward the main book.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.mode_requirement: Bring nearby calm summoned souls. Theatre/Council need three; Fortress/Relay need two. Ball games need a held ball; Relay needs a held parcel.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.camp_help: Place and use service blocks, bind a store, supply real materials and choose a companion.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.select_help: Open Crew to choose who will work or take a personal quest.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.garden_help: Give the soul a real hoe. Mature supported crops within four blocks of the marker are harvested and replanted.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.home_help: The soul approaches your bench while you are nearby. Combat and explicit orders override the routine.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.furniture_help: Consumes four oak planks and one amethyst shard from your bound store.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.visitor_help: Use your Visitor Board. Identity and offers save; leaving the world does not reroll them.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.group_photo_help: At least two calm nearby souls form a pose. The photograph is saved locally in the existing album.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.crew_help: Your existing native souls keep their level, tier, equipment, AI and personal progress.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.personal_help.0: Pet and feed this soul, then walk 100 blocks together. Choose a promise below.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.personal_help.1: Win together in its personality's activity: Brave Archivist, Gentle Treasure, Curious Loop, Playful Bowling, Watchful Fortress, Serene Mirrors.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.personal_help.2: Return calmly to camp, introduce a soul friend and hold one real paper for the closing letter.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.personal_help.3: Your ending, marked letter and signature gesture are saved. Your friendship continues.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.club_help: Choose at your bound Club Pennant. Shared activity victories develop the club.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.collection_help: First clears grant fixed relics. One utility slot; no stacking damage bonuses or new kill credit.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.new_cycle_help: Your army, old progression and book ending stay. New-cycle ruler seals reset and encounter scaling stops growing after cycle three.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.builder_help: Use SO115:mode:seed:difficulty:rule. Only listed modes, difficulty 0–2 and rules 0–3 are accepted.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.custom_safe: A challenge uses your real party, the normal activity slot and ordinary reward checks.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.release_help: These pages ship with the mod. Updating the mod updates its book while keeping stable step IDs.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.history_help: The original Codex keeps its earlier guides, plus the Journey chapters explain how the systems connect.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.within_four: Stand within four blocks of the actual target. The button alone never completes the task.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.copper_cost: Clear enemies and hold at least two copper ingots. Each repair consumes two.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.pumpkin_required: Wear a carved pumpkin and stand within five blocks of the actual guest.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.kick_help: Stand within three blocks and aim with your camera. This closes the menu so you can move.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.pass_help: The same physical item moves between nearby participants; no copied parcel is created.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.chair_help: Wait for the music to stop, approach the actual empty seat, then sit.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.pull_help: Stay by the rope. Pull with the bell; tapping constantly gives no extra force.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.paint_help: Tap to cycle color, then choose a board square. Your soul walks there and paints it. Match the displayed pattern.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.token_help: Pick up real tokens and stand beside the marked payment stone. Ordinary seals and diamonds are untouched.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.auction_help: Approach the traders. Bid one more; payment happens only when your winning offer closes.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.abandon_help: No victory reward. Existing army progression remains, and the real game item is returned or left collectible.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.lessons_help: Read these at any time. The book never requires deliberate companion deaths or a Chosen lottery win.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.recipes_help: These are the actual registered crafting recipes. Click an item to see its native ingredient grid.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.unavailable: That action is not ready. Check distance, party, materials, current activity and its requirements.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.book_welcome: Your Journey book is here. Open it, or use H → My Journey Book. It remembers your progress.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.gate_requirement: Bind a Soul Sanctuary and own at least one soul before entering. Creative can inspect the realm freely.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.gate_awake: The Journey Gateway is awake. Survival entry costs twenty energy; Creative entry and return are free.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.gate_frame: Build a 4×5 frame around this keystone with a 2×3 opening. Soul Gate Frames, obsidian and crying obsidian work.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.realm_unavailabl: The realm or a safe private plot is unavailable. Your energy was not spent.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.preparing: Preparing your private homestead. Stay near the gate for automatic entry when it is ready.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.time_up: The adventure timer ended. Your existing souls and progression remain.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.party_fallen: The expedition party is unavailable. Check reserve and Cemetery before another attempt.
odyssey.shadowsovereign.run_won: Victory! Open the activity page to claim it once.

odyssey.shadowsovereign.train_station: Station %s: clear the tracks and repair before departure.

mythic.shadowsovereign.menu_help: A hidden sanctum. An ancient creature. A bond earned in battle.
mythic.shadowsovereign.hidden_help: Explore the shores of your kingdom. One rare sanctum lies beyond the familiar ruins. Defeat its guardian to earn its soul, guaranteed.

mythic.shadowsovereign.discovered: You found the Sanctum of the Hollow Cage. Something within is waking.
mythic.shadowsovereign.awakened: The Soul Devourer stirs. Watch its claws, charge and glowing cage.
mythic.shadowsovereign.pending: Soul secured. Your army is full; make room and claim it here. No second victory is required.
